channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: A young couple currently living in Manchester are hoping to up sticks to the Cheshire countryside with their young daughter. They have requested a four-bedroom, detached family home with a large, private garden, and Nicki Chapman has a very tempting selection of properties that suit the brief, as well as a mystery house that makes them reconsider their wish list.
